subject: Call time needs adjustment
text:
I need to move our call because I cannot join at the usual time. Something unexpected came up at the end of the day, and it worked out better than I first expected. After I mentioned the difficulty with the survey form to the office assistant, she checked an older folder and found a completed copy under a different title. That means I do not have to re-enter everything by hand, and I can avoid the evening work block I had planned around it. The good news arrived just as I was leaving, so the only thing left is to tell you the call still needs a new time.

If it is convenient, late tomorrow afternoon may be simplest, though I can also speak early before classes if you prefer. I would rather not keep the original slot, since I may need a short buffer before my lab session starts. Please choose whichever window suits you better, and I will send a brief confirmation afterward. I appreciate your flexibility, and I would like to finish this cleanly without a second cancellation.

I found the corrected version just after five, which left me feeling relieved rather than rushed. Since the paperwork is now simpler, I expect our call to be shorter than I first thought. I will mark the pages that still need a supervisor signature, and I can share a one-page summary before we talk. That should leave us with only the scheduling and wording questions to settle. If you receive it and see anything missing, I can respond with a note before the new time.

Kind regards,
